verdict.rationale: Intel provides official developer tooling (oneAPI, oneDNN, VTune Profiler, PyTorch optimizations, SYCL interoperability) targeting Core Ultra CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, showing real optimization guidance and tooling investment for this architecture. However, evidence is entirely vendor-sourced with no independent corroboration of compiler maturity, OS-level tier-one treatment, or broader ecosystem support (e.g., GCC/LLVM upstream status, Linux kernel support specifics). Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of compiler maturity, explicit OS tier-one support statements, and broader ecosystem tooling beyond Intel's own oneAPI suite.
